title: Boolean login bypass SQLi
impact: Attacker can potentially bypass authentication or retrieve unauthorized records
remediation: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements to prevent SQL injection

title: Union based SQLi
impact: Attacker may extract sensitive database information including user email addresses and password hashes
remediation: Use parameterized queries and restrict database account privileges, ensure passwords are securely hashed and sensitive database fields are not unnecessarily exposed

title: Reflected XSS on search bar
impact: attacker may execute malicious JavaScript in a victim's browser through a crafted URL
remediation: Apply context-aware output encoding and sanitize untrusted input

title: Stored XSS on admin feedback
impact: Attacker may store malicious scripts that execute when administrators or other users access the affected page
remediation: Sanitize user-submitted content and apply context-aware output encoding when displaying stored data
